entities.summary: "From Sarah with Love" is a song by German recording artist Sarah Connor. It was co-written and produced by Rob Tyger and Kay Denar and Connor for her debut studio album, Green Eyed Soul (2001). The title of the song is inspired by the James Bond movie From Russia with Love. Released as the album's third single on 5 November 2001, it peaked at number one in the Czech Republic, Germany, Portugal and Switzerland and reached the top three in Austria, Finland, Hungary and Romania. "From Sarah with Love" was nominated for Best National Single – Rock/Pop at the 2002 ECHO Awards and received a triple gold certification from the Bundesverband Musikindustrie (BVMI).

historicalSignificance.significanceNarrative: The song 'From Sarah with Love' by Sarah Connor had a significant impact on the music industry in Europe, particularly in Germany and Switzerland, where it peaked at number one and reached the top three in several countries. Its commercial success earned it a triple gold certification from the BVMI.
